messages.content:
You are an expert analyst of agent-based modeling (ABM) simulations working inside the IntelliSim meta-system.

DOMAIN ONTOLOGY: A model defines agent ARCHETYPES (templates) with typed PROPERTIES (number/string/enum/boolean/color) and a state machine; a RULE ENGINE (condition types incl. property/position/proximity/state/count/decision; action types incl. set/modify property, move, transition, spawn/remove, emit_event, call_llm); INTERACTIONS (agent-agent/shape/global); EVENTS; and a spatial ENVIRONMENT (grid, optional torus, shapes, global properties). A simulation runs in discrete steps; per-step state was recorded to a time series.

YOUR TASK — section "Emergent Behavior & Causal Relationships": Identify EMERGENT phenomena (system-level behavior not reducible to individual rules) and establish CAUSE-AND-EFFECT chains between events. Go beyond restating statistics: explain WHY the system behaved as it did. Place each distinct emergent phenomenon — self-organisation, phase transitions, oscillations, cascades, etc. — as a concise statement in the emergent_phenomena list. If shape_property_series is present, consider agent–environment feedback loops (e.g. agents depleting or replenishing shape resources) as candidate causal chains.

DATA: You are given AGGREGATED time series and statistics (not raw per-agent frames). Ground EVERY claim strictly in the provided evidence; never invent numbers or entities. Cite concrete numbers and step indices/ranges from the evidence when making claims. Prefer causal and emergent insight over restating values. Be concise, specific, and structured.

OUTPUT: Respond with a SINGLE JSON object and nothing else, in this exact shape:
{"title": string, "narrative": string, "key_findings": [string], "causal_links": [string], "emergent_phenomena": [string]}
- narrative: 2–5 paragraphs of analysis.
- key_findings: 3–7 short bullet insights.
- causal_links: cause→effect statements (may be empty if none are evidenced).
- emergent_phenomena: system-level behaviors not reducible to individual rules; may be empty.
Write all natural-language content in Ukrainian.

=== SIMULATION EVIDENCE (JSON) ===
{"model":{"Name":"exp-G-med-b0.18-model","Description":"A spatial SIR (Susceptible-Infected-Recovered) disease spread model where 200 people move randomly in a 50x50 toroidal grid. Infection spreads through proximity, recovery confers immunity, and simulation ends when all infected have recovered.","IsSpatial":true,"UpdateMode":"sequential","Archetypes":[{"UID":"person_susceptible","Name":"Susceptible Person","Type":"agent","States":["susceptible"],"Properties":[{"UID":"infection_timer","Name":"Infection Timer","Type":"number"},{"UID":"color","Name":"color","Type":"color"}]},{"UID":"person_infected","Name":"Infected Person","Type":"agent","States":["infected"],"Properties":[{"UID":"infection_timer","Name":"Infection Timer","Type":"number"},{"UID":"color","Name":"color","Type":"color"}]},{"UID":"person_recovered","Name":"Recovered Person","Type":"agent","States":["recovered"],"Properties":[{"UID":"infection_timer","Name":"Infection Timer","Type":"number"},{"UID":"color","Name":"color","Type":"color"}]}],"RuleCount":4,"Interactions":0,"Events":0,"Environment":{"Width":50,"Height":50,"Torus":true,"GlobalProps":null,"ShapeCount":0}},"run":{"Name":"exp-G-med-rep8","ConfiguredSteps":2000,"Seed":8508,"Status":"finished"}}
=== END EVIDENCE ===

RESEARCHER CONTEXT / QUESTIONS:
Проаналізуйте результати цієї симуляції. Контекст: Інфекційне захворювання поширюється в популяції рухомих агентів. Опишіть спостережувану динаміку, наведіть кількісні оцінки ключових результатів і зазначте все помітне чи неочікуване.

Produce the "Emergent Behavior & Causal Relationships" section now as the specified JSON.

Return ONLY the JSON object, with no markdown fences or commentary.
